scope: Unprofiled exclusive paired host CPU windows; each has 100 compilations and one untimed warmup. Native and plain applications differ; only compare the same arm/binary across QEMU builds.
limitations: Two unprofiled samples per variant on this host and GCC test input; not a general SPEC score or hardware speed estimate.
Candidate uses Clang/full LTO while original controls use their original GCC build; measured gain includes source and host-toolchain improvements.

Plain machine/CPU and executable are held fixed within stock-plain/fork-plain, but candidate-versus-stock includes different host build choices. Platform/plain also changes kernel and CPU discovery paths.
Realtime omits icount; keep it separate from same-clock comparisons.
Full-suite correctness uses exact previously officially qualified hashes and guest image validators; fresh official SPEC comparators are not rerun.

evidence.scope: Full workload receipts, captured outputs, safety and portability logs, isolation proof, diagnostic x264 sample and final paired timing records. Input staging directories/disks omitted; immutable inputs and binaries identified by hashes in qualification records and prior bounded evidence.
